(3) Wait for full replication catch-up via pg_last_wal_receive_lsn matching pg_last_wal_replay_lsn on the replica. (4) Promote replica with pg_ctl promote. Gotcha: the promoted replica is now the only primary — you have no failover capacity until you provision a new replica from snapshot. Rollback path: stop writes again, point DNS back if old primary is healthy; otherwise restore from backup (5-minute RPO). This is high-impact; only execute under IC direction.
